doc.name: DiscoverIA
doc.instructions: Read-only access to DiscoverIA (https://discoveria.ai), an independent registry of AI-assisted scientific claims and of where their evaluation stands. A status says where the evaluation of a claim stands, not whether the result is true; always give the date the status was observed. Start with search_announcements, then get_announcement for details. Pass lang='fr' or 'en'. Data are CC BY 4.0: credit DiscoverIA.

tools.name: search_announcements
tools.title: Search the DiscoverIA registry
tools.description: Search DiscoverIA's registry of AI-assisted scientific claims by free text, status, lab, discipline and announcement date. Returns paginated entries with their current status, the date that status was observed and a link to the entry's page. A status says where the evaluation of a claim stands, not whether the result is true. Entries from the frozen Erdős-wiki archive have statuses dated at the freeze.

query.description: Free text matched against title, claimant, id, discipline and nature. All words must match; accents and case are ignored. Omit to list everything.

status.description: Keep only entries with this status (see list_statuses).

lab.description: Lab slug from DiscoverIA's lab report, e.g. 'openai', 'google-deepmind', 'anthropic', 'harmonic', 'math-inc'. Matches claims announced by the lab and results obtained by others with its systems. The Erdős-wiki archive is not attributed to labs.

announced_from.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Keeps entries whose announcement period ends on or after this date (a claim dated '2026-02' matches announced_from '2026-02-15').

announced_to.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Keeps entries whose announcement period starts on or before this date.

include_archive.description: Include the frozen archive of T. Tao's AI-Erdős wiki (about 520 entries). Default true.

lang.description: Language of titles, labels and texts: 'fr' (French) or 'en' (English). Default 'en'. Use the user's language.

tools.name: get_announcement
tools.title: Get one registry entry
tools.description: Get one entry of the DiscoverIA registry by id: claim, claimant, current status with its rule, dated status history with sources, verifiers, links, statement fidelity, events, related frontiers and the plain-language summary. A status says where the evaluation stands, not whether the result is true.

id.description: Entry id (slug), e.g. 'gauss-sphere-packing-dim8', as returned by search_announcements.

lang.description: Language of titles, labels and texts: 'fr' (French) or 'en' (English). Default 'en'. Use the user's language.

tools.name: list_statuses
tools.title: List the statuses and their counts
tools.description: List DiscoverIA's six evaluation statuses for scientific claims (and the provisional product statuses) with their definitions and the number of entries in each. A status says where the evaluation stands, not whether the result is true.

lang.description: Language of titles, labels and texts: 'fr' (French) or 'en' (English). Default 'en'. Use the user's language.

annotations.title: List the statuses and their counts

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.title: Recent status changes and news feed
tools.description: Latest status changes in the registry (last 90 days, with source) and the latest items of DiscoverIA's feed (last 30 days: sciences, models and labs, apps, devices).

kind.description: 'status' for status changes only, 'feed' for feed items only, 'all' for both. Default 'all'.

limit.description: Maximum items per list, 1 to 50. Default 20.

lang.description: Language of titles, labels and texts: 'fr' (French) or 'en' (English). Default 'en'. Use the user's language.

annotations.title: Recent status changes and news feed

tools.name: get_frontier
tools.title: Get a frontier and its current record
tools.description: Frontiers track the best known bound of a quantity (e.g. a kissing number) and who moved it. With an id: the frontier, its current lower and upper records (exact values as strings, never rounded) and its series. Without an id: the list of frontiers with their current records.

id.description: Frontier id, e.g. 'kissing-d11'. Omit to list all frontiers.

lang.description: Language of titles, labels and texts: 'fr' (French) or 'en' (English). Default 'en'. Use the user's language.

annotations.title: Get a frontier and its current record

tools.name: get_citation
tools.title: Cite a registry entry
tools.description: Dated citation of a registry entry in APA and/or BibTeX, with its status and the date that status was observed. Data are CC BY 4.0, credit DiscoverIA.

id.description: Entry id (slug), e.g. 'gauss-sphere-packing-dim8', as returned by search_announcements.

lang.description: Language of titles, labels and texts: 'fr' (French) or 'en' (English). Default 'en'. Use the user's language.
